Overview.text: The company's latest quarter showed a year‑over‑year revenue increase, indicating continued growth momentum.

Market Positioning and Growth Outlook.text: Operating expenses rose sharply, widening the operating loss, which suggests a weakening competitive position.

insight.text: Insight: Operating loss of $23.6 million increased $10.7 million and adjusted operating loss of $21.3 million increased $10.9 million, both as compared to the prior year period, primarily due to higher selling, general and administrative expenses and direct operating expenses.
